title: Tech Note: Spell-check and Dictionary
author: Thang Nguyen
featured_technology: SET DICTIONARY command and language/variant constants
WR SET AREA PROPERTY (wr on the fly spellchecking) for 4D Write areas
Get 4D folder command for locating dictionary storage
SEND PACKET / RECEIVE PACKET for merging dictionary files

historical_commentary.text: Thang Nguyen documents 4D 2004's then-new integrated spell-checker: how to enable it declaratively via the property list or 4D Write preferences, or programmatically via SPELL CHECKING and WR SET AREA PROPERTY, how to switch between the four bundled language dictionaries with SET DICTIONARY, and how to merge personal .dic files by hand since 4D doesn't support multiple simultaneous personal dictionaries out of the box. The core spell-check commands and dictionary architecture described here are still part of 4D today with only incremental changes, making this note largely still relevant as a reference for classic form-based text/alpha field spell-checking, though 4D Write itself has since been superseded by 4D Write Pro for rich document editing.
related_updates: 4D Write Pro (introduced 2016) is now the primary rich-text/document editing area in 4D, superseding classic 4D Write; its spell-check configuration differs from the WR SET AREA PROPERTY approach shown here
The core SPELL CHECKING and SET DICTIONARY commands for Alpha/Text fields remain part of the current 4D language with the same fundamental behavior described in this note
